plugins.name: trellis-ae
plugins.description: AE-facing outbound suite: cold-outbound, closed-lost re-engagement, local door-knock/lunch prep, in-thread follow-ups, an accountability checker, and contact-finder. All email is drafted into the AE's Gmail for review — nothing is sent automatically.
